intent.responsibility: Own one social post Screen with authored identity, selected media, written caption and social actions.
intent.visualBoundary: Compose optional system chrome and composer around one four-zone Component Stack: Header Stack, Media, Bubble and social Icon Bar.
intent.runtimeBehavior: Expose the exact Bubble Runtime contract so caption text and Write-on timing remain product inputs.
intent.forwarding: Forward the complete exact Bubble Runtime document to the declared Bubble slot; keep Header, Media, social actions and optional composer Variant-owned.
intent.temporalOwnership: The Screen owns duration and chrome visibility; Bubble owns Write-on; Media and embedded Components keep their local timelines.
intent.productionContext: Resolve only through the exact Production Screen to Shot owner Actor to Theme and Device context.
